native/resume-token/current.reason: Wire-level boundary placement during resume replay. Production was consistent across the two runs (r1 nmuuicyas, r2 nmuukwo6n): ADD[1], boundary+token, change b, boundary+token, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token. fireemu strict sends: ADD[1], boundary+token, change b, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token. Native-gRPC client effect: a raw gRPC listener sees the boundary frames production sends between the replayed changes and CURRENT, and fireemu does not send them. SDK effect not measured: from the Web SDK source a reconnect that stays online raises a remote event at every global boundary, so production may give an intermediate fromCache:true snapshot where fireemu gives the document together with CURRENT; an online-reconnect case in packet L2 is the way to measure it. Issue fs-listen-resume-replay-boundaries.
native/resume-token/current.production: ADD[1], boundary+token, change b, boundary+token, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token
native/resume-token/current.fireemu: ADD[1], boundary+token, change b, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token

native/existence-filter/without-expected.reason: A different answer to the same resume, not a placement difference. Production was consistent across the two runs (r1 nmuuicyas, r2 nmuukwo6n): ADD[1], boundary+token, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token | filters 1:1:0:0:0. fireemu strict sends: ADD[1], boundary+token, change c (removed target ids), documentDelete b, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token. Production tells the client of the removals only through the count (a client holding 3 documents sees count 1); fireemu sends the removals as messages and no filter. Native-gRPC client effect: a raw gRPC listener receives two document messages that production does not send and no filter. SDK effect not measured. Which answer production gives depends on its history window, which is not observable; it is recorded, not fitted. Issue fs-listen-resume-replay-boundaries.
native/existence-filter/without-expected.fireemu: ADD[1], boundary+token, change c (removed target ids), documentDelete b, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token

native/resume-token/older.reason: Existence filter on resume or on an initial snapshot. Both production runs sent it; fireemu never sends an ExistenceFilter. Production was consistent across the two runs (r1 nmuuicyas, r2 nmuukwo6n): ADD[1], boundary+token, change a, change b, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token | filters 1:2:0:0:0. fireemu strict sends: ADD[1], boundary+token, change a, change b, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token. Native-gRPC client effect: a raw gRPC listener does not receive the filter by which a client checks its held set against the server's count (a 0/0/0 bloom filter is count-only). SDK effect not measured: the SDK resets a target whose held set differs from the count, and with exact diffs the counts agree, but no SDK recording of a case that differs shows it. Issue fs-listen-resume-replay-boundaries.
